name: Alkyl Amines Chemicals Ltd
title: Alkyl Amines Chemicals Ltd-$ - 506767 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Post-war ammonia cost doubling (INR50 to INR100+/kg) passed to customers, margins temporarily widened; management sees bottom but methylamine overcapacity from Aarti caps recovery and volume guided only 5-10%.

utilisation.quote: on an average, we must be having between 60% and 85% capacity utilization

capex.peers_comment: Aarti commissioned a methylamine plant into an already overcapacity market; Balaji executing a 18,000 t acetonitrile plant
capex.quote: the capex looking at is just completing this project and maintenance capex

triggers.label: Chinese aceto imports easing
triggers.quote: they have reduced their imports because they have raised their prices
triggers.highlight: reduced their imports because they have raised their prices

triggers.label: Methylamine overcapacity from new entrant
triggers.quote: there is a bit of overcapacity of methylamines, and that will take some time to fill up

triggers.label: Acetonitrile price ~INR200+/kg vs ~INR140-150 last year
triggers.quote: Last year's average, it came down to something like INR140, INR150.

triggers.label: Balaji 18,000 t ACN plant coming
triggers.quote: our competitor, Balaji, is executing a large plant for ACN, which is coming up in the current year. So 18,000 tons.
triggers.highlight: Balaji, is executing a large plant for ACN

guidance.quote: we expect that the next year will be like a normal year, which is about 5% to 10% growth rate
definitely, I think we do foresee some improvement in our margins in the next year
it will be around INR80 crores to INR90 crores

guidance.value: beginning of next quarter (Q2 FY27), mechanical completion end June
guidance.quote: It will probably be the beginning of the next quarter that the project will get commissioned.

red_flags.label: Ammonia supply shock; contracts now short-term
red_flags.quote: the ammonia contracts are all short term because prices are high and nobody is willing to commit

red_flags.label: Margin gain may be inventory-driven, temporary
red_flags.quote: the rise in margins may be just purely inventories

evasions.quote: we don't talk about individual products

evasions.topic: R&D pipeline and new product count
evasions.quote: we do not talk about our R&D products till the product is in the market
